instructions.title: Instruction Manual
instructions.description: A complete guide to making the most of all WaxPro features.

calculator.p1: The Cost Calculator allows you to quickly determine the production cost of a single candle. Enter the cost for each component:
calculator.li1: The cost of the wax you use.
calculator.li3: The cost of the container (jar, mold, etc.).
calculator.p2: Click 'Calculate Total' to see the final cost. You can use the 'Reset' button to clear the fields and 'Share' to copy the result.

recipe_calculator.p1: This tool is essential for creating precise recipes. It helps you calculate the correct proportions of wax, fragrance, and color based on the desired total weight.
recipe_calculator.li1: Choose the unit of measurement (grams, ounces, etc.).
recipe_calculator.li2: Enter the total weight of the candle you want to produce.
recipe_calculator.li3: Use the slider to define the fragrance percentage.
recipe_calculator.li4: Use the slider to define the color percentage.
recipe_calculator.p2: By clicking 'Calculate Recipe', the app will show you the exact quantities of each ingredient.
recipe_calculator.p3: You can also enter the cost per unit of materials to calculate the total recipe cost.

inventory.p1: The Inventory section is the heart of your management. Here you can track all your finished products. To use this section, you must be registered.
inventory.p2: Add a new product by specifying its name, initial quantity, reorder threshold (to receive a warning when stock is low), production cost, and selling price.
inventory.p3: For each product, you can record a sale ('Sell'), add new stock ('Load'), or manage a return ('Return').

report.p1: The Financial Report gives you an overview of your sales performance. You can filter data by day, week, month, or year. The main cards show:
report.li1: The total profit generated in the selected period.
report.li2: The total number of units sold.
report.li3: The total value of goods currently in stock.
report.p2: The chart below shows the trend of profit and units sold over time, giving you a clear view of your performance. You can also export a detailed report in PDF.

recipes.p1: The Recipe Archive lets you save recipes calculated in the Recipe Calculator, so you don't have to re-enter everything from scratch every time you make the same candle again.
recipes.p2: You can rename or delete saved recipes at any time. The free plan includes 2 savable recipes; beyond that, an active subscription is required.

settings.p1: In the Settings section, you can customize your experience on WaxPro.
settings.li1: Manage your profile data and log in or out of the app.
settings.li2: View your subscription status and manage your plan through Google Play (available only in the Android app).
settings.li3: Choose between the light and dark theme for the application interface.
settings.li4: Set the default language and currency for the entire application.
